The original data point associated with that best-matching key is then used to handle the query: in RAG, the document that is best suited to answer the question is typically prefixed to the query. candidates.title: GHARP: Real-Time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-Scale Reconstruction Prior
candidates.summary: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. We decouple the problem into an identity stage that builds a representation of the subject’s geometry and appearance offline, and an animation stage that predicts expression-dependent residuals on top of it at runtime. candidates.title: An AI Spore agent built a Godot game, then tested and revised it with bots
candidates.summary:
I’m building Spore, an Apache-2.0 runtime for persistent AI agents. Here’s an experiment using it to build and test a small Godot game.

The agent wrote the game, generated its art and sound in code, and wrote bots to test its balance over seeded runs. It passed the first prompt’s targets—but reviewing the results exposed gaps those targets didn’t cover.

A second prompt added requirements. The agent improved its search, revised the bargain mechanic and fixed the ending. Nobody edited the game by hand.
